commits.author: mmoollee101-lab
commits.subject: Bring window to foreground before screenshot in /preview
commits.body:
Use SetForegroundWindow via PowerShell to activate the process window
before capturing. Walks the process tree from cmd.exe to find the
actual GUI window (e.g. python.exe child of cmd.exe).
Applies to both script (GUI) and exe preview modes.

commits.author: mmoollee101-lab
commits.subject: Fix GUI process kill: use taskkill /T /F to kill entire process tree
commits.body:
child.kill() only kills cmd.exe, leaving python.exe running.
taskkill /T /F kills the whole tree (cmd.exe → python.exe).

commits.author: mmoollee101-lab
commits.subject: Rewrite resolveDirectory: token matching instead of regex parsing
commits.body:
Instead of trying to parse Korean grammar with fragile regex chains,
extract tokens from input, filter stopwords, and match each token
against actual folder names in the filesystem. Handles any sentence
structure like "바탕화면에 Glit 이라는 폴더로 이동하자".
